text: The purpose of this report is to appoint directors to The Eglinton Way Business Improvement Area (BIA) Board of Management. The Eglinton Way Business Improvement Area (BIA) falls within two Community Council boundaries.

City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appoint the following nominees to The Eglinton Way Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below at pleasure of Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon afterwards as successors are appointed: Peter Cook Nick Rukaj
